run_APPO_training: run the APPO async PPO reinforcement learning algorithm main loop with configured hyperparameters
add_cli_args_APPO: add APPO-specific CLI arguments like rollout length, batch size, and PPO clip ratio to an argparse parser
init_workers_APPO: initialize actor workers, policy workers, and learner workers as separate multiprocessing processes
process_report_APPO: process stats reports from learner and actor workers including episodic rewards and training summaries
report_experiment_summaries_APPO: write experiment summaries like FPS, sample throughput, and avg rewards to TensorBoard
